about: Drives under flake quarantine (test-suite restructure, 2026-11-09; the flake rule lives in tests/TIER-MAP.md). A quarantined drive is removed from the Tier A core set and from Tier B family sets by scripts/select-tier.py: it does not gate the fast tiers until it is hardened and Andrew (or the round that hardens it) removes the entry. It still runs - and still gates - in the Tier C full battery and the nightly battery, where its surface matters most and a flake is handled by the one-focused-re-run rule. Entry requires TWO flake records under the new rule, or a standing record of repeated flakes from the audit sweep.

quarantined.reason: Repeated FLAKE-classified failures in the 2026-11-09 audit sweep (the T3 family across the census-fix round and earlier). Excluded from Tier A gating per the restructure ruling until hardened; its finish/Undo guard coverage lives in drive146 C0/C1b in the meantime, and drive89 itself still runs at Tier C and nightly.

Two FLAKE-classified failures with the identical signature - D1-D5 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading stitched)' with the stored workM undefined - in run 43029275837 shard 3 (drive156-harden branch, tests-only diff) and run 43060145115 attempt 1 shard 3 (spring-t0-fix branch); passed 13/13 on the one focused re-run and locally both times. Excluded from Tier A/B gating per the two-flake rule until hardened in the drive186-harden round; still runs at Tier C and nightly.
